title: District Sports and Learning Complex Swimming Pools Replastering Services

onscreen_lines.desc: Pool 1- Tot Pool - Sports & Learning Complex Water Surface Area = 873 sq ft Perimeter = 118' -9" ft. Remove existing pool plaster from walls, floor, steps, and transitions. Prepare exposed pool surfaces and seal any exposed rebar with epoxy.\ Remove and replace existing side-wall steps at designated locations. Furnish and install new white or blue commercial quartz plaster. Install new main drain grates, frames, and mounting hardware. Perform acid wash upon completion of plaster installation. Provide pool startup services, including initial brushing, spot vacuuming, and water treatment. Remove debris and equipment and leave the pool area clean and ready for operation. Remove Toys, bolts and foundation brackets Replace Toe Tile and install after plaster has been completed Black tile surrounding the edge of the pool : is to be cut below the existing surface and chipped out Do not replace the existing tile: the area is to be properly prepared so that the new plaster can merge with the existing surface.
